messages:
Alice K: Starting a config-only deploy now — routing.weight us_geo: 0.85 -> 0.80; batch.max_tokens: 512 -> 384; request.timeout_ms: 2200 -> 2000. Canary 5% traffic, change window 22:00 PST / 06:00 UTC. Will pin model v3.1 for this rollout. FYI dedicated tenants unaffected.
DeployBot: Deploy started (cfg-20260319-08). Canary at 5%. CI checks: unit/integration/e2e OK. Monitor: https://ops.redwood/metrics/cfg-20260319-08
Ben T: Quick Q — pin means traffic still uses same model weights, right? Also any tenant-level overrides we should worry about?
Alice K: Correct — model weights pinned to v3.1 for consistency. No tenant-level model overrides will change. This is only routing/batching/timeouts.
Carla M: Heads up — KV cache pressure can spike with lower batch sizes. Recommend enabling soft-fallback policy (fallback-model: v2.9) if p95 latency > 1.2s or mem pressure on hosts > 75%.
DeployBot: Canary healthy at 10m: p50=88ms, p95=420ms, errors=0.02%, kvcache miss rate unchanged. Logs: /logs/cfg-20260319-08
Dave S: Noted a small memory uptick on us-west-2 hosts; I restarted shard-12 (killed and let scheduler reschedule) — mem returned to normal. Suggest we pause the ramp to 20% until we validate next 30m of stability.
Alice K: Pausing ramp. Keeping at 5% until we get another 30m stable. I'll also add a short note to release notes.
DeployBot: Ramp paused at 5%. Next automated health check in 30m. To resume ramp run: `/deploy resume 1719973310` (needs eng-release approver).
Ben T: If we decide rollback, what's the exact rollback plan?
Alice K: Manual rollback: revert to snapshot cfg-20260317-03 (previous config), unpin model if needed. Runbook: platform team executes `/deploy rollback cfg-20260317-03` — expected completion <3min, plan includes draining new routing config and reverting batch/timeouts. Inform CS before rollback.
DeployBot: Reminder — change window ends 02:00 UTC; auto-unlock at 03:00 UTC if not explicitly closed. Alerts will escalate to on-call.
Carla M: Setting alerts: p95 > 600ms, error rate > 0.5%, and host mem > 80% for 2 consecutive mins. :thumbsup:
Eve O: Oncall here — ack, will watch the alerts and ping if anything trends. Thanks.
Alice K: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release note blurb and notify the CS rotation. If anyone sees anything odd DM me (Alice).
